anchor: list (g|l|d|a|c) [ <pattern> ]  Shows some or all items of a specific type.  The following items are supported: - g: command groups - l: log groups (only those encountered yet) - d: log groups with descriptions (only those that have descriptions) - a: asserts (only those hit yet) - c: crashes (only those failed yet)  If a pattern is specified only items matching that pattern are shown. A pattern can contain any character, letter, or a wildcard '*'.  Please note that assert and crash items have their line number appended to the current file name, e.g. debug.cpp(13).
